# Soulmate Scents

> Luxury Pakistani parfumerie crafting high-concentration Extraits de Parfum and Eau de Parfum (25% to 30% aromatic oil concentration) with complimentary nationwide delivery across Pakistan.

## Brand Summary
- **House:** Soulmate Scents
- **Specialty:** Handcrafted Extrait de Parfum and long-lasting fine fragrances formulated for warm-weather longevity (4 to 6 hours projection, 10 to 14 hours wear).
- **Shipping & Fulfilment:** Complimentary nationwide delivery across Pakistan with Cash on Delivery (COD) and signature gift packaging.
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +92 333 7615355
- **Email:** soulmatescents@gmail.com

## Primary Pages
- [Home](https://soulmatescents.com/): Editorial showcase of Soulmate Scents Extraits de Parfum and house heritage.
- [All Perfumes & Extraits](https://soulmatescents.com/perfumes): Full catalog of Men's, Women's, Unisex, Best Sellers, Premium, and Gold Edition fragrances.
- [Shop Catalog](https://soulmatescents.com/shop): Filterable fragrance storefront with prices in PKR and instant cart access.
- [About Our House](https://soulmatescents.com/about): Craftsmanship, oil concentration standards, and perfumery philosophy.
- [Concierge & Support](https://soulmatescents.com/contact): Direct concierge messaging, WhatsApp live chat, phone assistance, and studio appointments.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://soulmatescents.com/faq): Fragrance concentration comparison, longevity guidance, shipping, and return details.
